selection_timing: After the complete EXP-004 map and representative refinements. Its nearest irregular exterior became period-nine after longer integration; the new control check preserves that failure and does not replace EXP-004.

initialization: Every point and every integration step size independently restarts from the same declared initial state; no continuation or warm start from EXP-004.
irregular_support_rule: Both step sizes have no accepted peak period up to 32 and finite-time exponent greater than 0.005. This is finite-horizon irregular support, not proof of chaos or exclusion of longer transients/periods.
certificate_rule: Use the existing independent DOP853 full-state and Floquet certificate only when both step sizes accept the same positive peak period. Seed with the finest run. Agreement with EXP-004 is not required; all changed periods and failed certificates remain reported.

behavior.initialization: Finest-step terminal state of each independent control run

failure_rules: Exclusive attempt directory; no replacement or adaptive rerun
Save each complete point-step cell before the next and retain native failure payloads
Retain complete cells, diagnostics, progress and timeout/failure receipts if interrupted
Clean committed and pushed source gate before execution
No target outcomes before this plan and its executable code are pushed
claim_boundary: A bounded robustness check of repeating versus irregular neuron-potential and tanh-activation behavior at four fixed controls in this recurrent network. No chaos theorem, trained-model generalization, task accuracy, or optimization utility claim.
